target_semantics_lesson: Focus on year-over-year revenue growth for the specified fiscal quarter.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate AI demand, Blackwell adoption, and Data Center revenue. Measure other segments' growth and revenue weight for reconciliation.
causal_reasoning_lesson: AI demand and new products drive Data Center revenue, which mediates consolidated growth. Other segments can act as a counterweight.
counterevidence_lesson: Slower growth in non-Data Center segments can restrain overall consolidated revenue momentum.
calibration_lesson: Reconcile segment performance to consolidated revenue. Weak links in the causal chain reduce confidence in the final growth outlook.
